source_sha256_conventions: FC execution/Shape2/P23 hashes are exact reviewed UTF-8 Git source snapshot blobs; P14-P17 hashes are UTF-8 of Notion fetch <content> block after trim, bound to listed last_edited_at. Source text is not a separate mutable implementation authority.

frozen_semantics.triangle: upright isosceles, width/height finite strictly positive, local closed vertices (W/2,0),(W,H),(0,H), bbox center used for Snap, not centroid
frozen_semantics.connector: Connector/1 FreePoint-FreePoint Straight Line and Arrow(endDecoration Arrow); no attached target/route extension
frozen_semantics.geometry_and_style: Shape/2 derived Scene/bounds/hit/raster; preexisting Field Registry Fill/Stroke/Opacity/Lock; no SkPath persisted; preview/guide are per-view transient
frozen_semantics.creation_flow: same InputRouter/Interaction Session, one InsertObjects of exactly one object per valid confirmed Up; pending semantic outcome retains identity; no Operation on Move/Cancel
frozen_semantics.far_axis_snap: visible finite viewport-bounded axis strips; deterministic center/edge ranking and hysteresis in logical pixels; no canonical guide; no silent Up jump
frozen_semantics.commands: typed Common Facade future-create options separated from selected-object changes, coherent revisioned readback; Product Shell and Debug UI are clients of one owner
frozen_semantics.editor_history: single Op per edit; handle resize one SetTransforms, numeric size one SetObjectSize, style/lock one PatchProperties, order SetPlacements, delete DeleteObjects; conditional same-lane inverse preimage and complete dependent closure
frozen_semantics.locked: visible locked object selectable/unlockable but ordinary local editor manipulation blocked; no global canonical parser ban
frozen_semantics.platform: Windows/Web/Android adapters share C++ semantic/interaction owner; preserve ICF binding/surface/metrics generation and four separate Applied/Presented/Axis LocalDurable/CloudSynced facts
frozen_semantics.mixed_clients: explicit reader/writer capability gate, fail closed for unsupported writable peers, no lossy downgrade/read-only claim without proof

forbidden_decisions: new protobuf tags or frozen V1 descriptor edits
